headline: Hubtown Limited: Copy of Newspaper Publication
sum: Copy of Newspaper Publication - Hubtown Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication about the Company Scheme Petition filed for sanctioning the proposed Scheme of Arrangement ( Scheme ) in the nature of merger /…
detail: Copy of Newspaper Publication - Hubtown Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication about the Company Scheme Petition filed for sanctioning the proposed Scheme of Arrangement ( Scheme ) in the nature of merger / amalgamation of 25 West Realty Private Limited ( Transferor Company ) with Hubtown Limited ( Transferee Company ) under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013, was admitted and the date for final hearing and disposal of the said Company Petition is fixed as on Thursday, September 10, 2026
